definitions.explanation: A mechanical device for transporting people or goods between floors of a building. A formal or technical term for what is commonly called エレベーター in everyday speech.

examples.japanese: {昇降機|しょうこうき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{点検中|てんけんちゅう}→点検中：10259_tenkenchuu⟧です。
⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{昇降機|しょうこうき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{設置|せっち}→設置：09750_secchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧づけられて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Installation of an elevator is mandatory in the building.

examples.japanese: ⟦{車椅子|くるまいす}→車椅子：10533_kurumaisu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{昇降機|しょうこうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ご⟦{利用|りよう}→利用：01752_riyou⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Wheelchair users, please use the elevator.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{昇降|しょうこう}→昇降：15147_shoukou⟧ (ascending and descending) and ⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧ (machine). This is the formal/legal term for elevators and lifts, used in building codes, safety regulations, and official signage.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {昇降機|しょうこうき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{設置|せっち}→設置：09750_secchi⟧: installation of an elevator
- {昇降機|しょうこうき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{点検|てんけん}→点検：09765_tenken⟧: elevator inspection
- {昇降機|しょうこうき}⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧: elevator inspection/certification
- {小荷物|こにもつ}{昇降機|しょうこうき}: dumbwaiter (small freight elevator)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦エレベーター→エレベーター：01340_erebeetaa⟧: elevator — the everyday word used in conversation and most signage
- ⟦リフト→リフト：30409_rifuto⟧: lift — often used for ski lifts, wheelchair lifts, or platform lifts
- ⟦エスカレーター→エスカレーター：01338_esukareetaa⟧: escalator — moving staircase; different mechanism

REGISTER:
Formal/technical. You will encounter this word in legal documents ({建築基準法|けんちくきじゅんほう} — Building Standards Act), safety inspection certificates, and formal public notices. In everyday speech, ⟦エレベーター→エレベーター：01340_erebeetaa⟧ is overwhelmingly preferred.
